result.brief: 提出 Roz 评测基准，用对比与连续任务直接探测潜动力学世界模型是否编码质量、摩擦、形变等物理属性，并指出重建误差与物理理解不相关。
result.reason: Introduces a benchmark probing whether latent dynamics world models encode physical properties (mass, friction, deformation) from latents, directly addressing world-model latent representation evaluation.
